items.caption: A Shang oracle-script form of 妹 has a compact, dense structure near the upper left, with tall strokes rising above it, a long stroke descending on the right, and a broad lower form extending to the left.
items.alt: Black oracle-script glyph on white: a dense upper-left cluster sits beneath tall strokes; a long right stroke descends nearly to the bottom, and the lower form spreads broadly left.
items.selection_reason: This identified oracle-script form adds an early graphic example. Its shape does not settle how the character was read in oracle-bone contexts.

limitations.text: Oracle-bone readings remain disputed, with dawn-related, place-name, and negative interpretations proposed. The form alone cannot resolve these readings or establish a path to the kinship sense “younger sister.”
